# SISU Sports Mouthguards

> > SISU Sports Mouthguards manufactures thin, moldable mouthguards and dental protection products featuring proprietary Diffusix Technology for athletes across multiple sports.

SISU specializes in custom-fit mouthguards designed for impact protection in sports like lacrosse, featuring multiple product lines (SISU AERO, MAX, 3D, GO, TETHER) and complementary dental products like SOVA Nightguards. The site provides comprehensive product information, fitting guides, and interactive tools to help customers select and properly mold their mouthguards.
